[[File:Monster Inspect icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Monster Inspect''' is a [[Utility spells|utility spell]] available in the [[standard spellbook]]. It requires level 42 [[Magic]] to cast, and grants 30.5 Magic [[experience]] per cast.

The spell must be cast on a [[monster]]. The spell provides basic information about the monster that is useful in combat. It is a weaker version of the [[Lunar spellbook|Lunar]] spell [[Monster Examine]].

==Information==
The spell gives information about the monster inspected in four tabs:
